personalInfo.title: Senior Software Engineer
personalInfo.summary: Results-driven Full-stack Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience specializing in PHP frameworks (Laravel, CodeIgniter), LAMP stack, Python, and ReactJS. Proven track record in building scalable FinTech applications serving millions of users, developing AI-powered solutions, and leading cross-functional development teams. Contributed to successful CMMI 2.0 Level 2 certification and skilled in Agile methodologies. Passionate about emerging technologies including AI/ML, Data Science, and Generative AI.

highlights: Integrated diverse platforms and technologies including BigQuery, Notion.io, Upwork API, GraphQL, OAuth 2.0, OneStepGPS, and Redtrack, ensuring seamless data exchange and functionality
Developed hands-on experience with N8n Workflows, building integrations with EvereeHR, Supabase, and Zoho Shifts for workflow automation
Built custom applications on ERPNext Frappe framework, customized system portals, and developed dynamic customer portals for enhanced user experience
Led data synchronization efforts between MongoDB and ERPNext across multiple doctypes including Bank Transactions, Employee, and Attendance Data
Managed deployment and configuration of custom apps on Frappe Cloud
Developed AI-powered SDR (Sales Development Representative) Agent application leveraging modern AI technologies for automated sales outreach and lead qualification
Designed and developed an Email Campaign Marketing Web Application from scratch, demonstrating full-stack expertise with Laravel and ReactJS
Refactored existing Laravel application into CodeIgniter to optimize performance and scalability, utilizing RESTful APIs and JavaScript for dynamic front-end interactions
Engineered and normalized database schemas to ensure efficient data storage and alignment with project requirements
Managed version control using Git, including branch merging and conflict resolution, maintaining streamlined development workflows
Implemented secure backend functionalities using Laravel 8, incorporating RESTful APIs and JWT tokens for robust authorization and authentication
Gained hands-on experience in ReactJS, seamlessly integrating APIs to enhance front-end functionality and user experience
Contributed to development and enhancement of a FinTech application serving millions of users, ensuring high performance and scalability
Directed and managed Agile sprints, prioritizing tasks and aligning development efforts with user needs and business goals
Implemented robust request validation for all POST data functions using regex algorithms to prevent SQL injection across the project
Designed and released secure money wallet supporting both cryptocurrency and fiat currencies, facilitating seamless transactions
Managed deployment pipelines ensuring smooth code deployment to production and development servers with quick turnaround for urgent fixes
Optimized database operations by developing MySQL procedures, transactions, functions, and triggers to handle complex data processing
Led a team of 4 junior developers, trained them on REST APIs and Git best practices
Developed webhook integrations to connect the application with third-party services
